name: SpaceX Starmind AI1 orbital data center satellite
note: Parity model for the v1.1 'SpaceX AI Satellites' type (Starmind AI1, a million-satellite dawn-dusk disk). Body frame: +Z nadir, +X (the bus's long axis) as close to the Sun as it can be, +Y along the span. A flat 10 x 3 x 0.6 m bus (it stacks PEZ-style) with its 3 x 0.6 m end to the Sun; two white radiators, 10 m long, standing up from its zenith face and hanging from its nadir face (20 m top to bottom), edge-on to the Sun; two wings of three 3.2 m strips spanning 70 m, each on one truss to a pivot at its root, turning about the span axis to face the Sun. 10 lobes: a million satellites fly it. Trusses, gimbals, spars, fittings and terminals are render-only detail.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: Nadir-pointing (+Z nadir), the bus's long axis (+X) as close to the Sun as it can be; the wings track the Sun about the span axis (+Y, perpendicular to the Sun-nadir plane, so they face it exactly), then tilt off it by the flare-mitigation slider
sources.source: Starmind AI1 as specified by the project owner (2026-09-24, from the AI1 spec sheet image): 'two large sun pointing panels with a wingspan of 70m', 'edge on radiators on the top and bottom of the bus with a deployed height of 20m'; the bus 'flatter, proportions similar to a door ... as wide as the solar panels', 'the radiators need to be the same length as that body', panels and radiators extending 'horizontally (panels) and vertically (radiators)' with 'widths contained within the length of the bus', 'flat, so it can pancake on top of other datacenters' (PEZ-style stacking), and 'the larger gap between the panels and the satellite body ... with large trusses'. Second round (same day): 'One truss, per half, extending to the solar panel central pivot'; 'the radiators are pointed up and down (relative to the Earth) ... This will leave the smallest face (by area) facing the sun directly on the chassis. With the panels freed to that center pivot single truss, they can maintain alignment'. AI1 spec sheet: 150 kW solar array at 250 W/m2, 110 m2 deployable liquid radiator, 150 kW peak compute. The tilt joint is the v1.1 legacy type's (SunTrackingTilted), kept for the slider.
